msg: I would advise to run with momentum as much as possible. There will be a period with each gnome in where they each gain the most mushrooms. This could last a few minutes or even up to 5 minutes. When you sense a gnome has hit a bad spell, it would be wise to switch. You should wait for confirmation of a bad spell which would be to wait until there were at least 2 periods in where there were a mushroom return of less than two. When this does occur, switch to another gnome. When you switch to another gnome and they all hit a poor mushroom return, stick with the new gnome until this gnome is confirmed to be weak.At this point switch back to your old gnome and try to hit a good momentum with this gnome. At this point you should be able to find a gnome which your prefer.
